A text came in saying my package is stuck and I have to pay a fee at a link. I haven't opened it yet. I have an iPhone. How do I report it?

Here is how to report an unopened spam text on your iPhone.
1. Open the **Messages** app.
2. Swipe left on the message, press the Delete control, then tap **Delete and Report Spam**.
You can't report a message after you've replied to it. Reporting doesn't stop the sender, so block them separately if you need to.
